title: Quadratic pair rank-one tester
statement: For each $n\ge 0$, consider a tester on addresses that are either vectors in $\mathbb F_2^n$ or $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$. It samples independent uniform vectors $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $z\in\mathbb F_2^{n^2}$, then queries $x$, $y$, the matrix obtained by reshaping $z$, and that matrix plus the outer product $xy^{\mathsf T}$. It accepts exactly when the product of the first two returned values equals the sum of the last two in $\mathbb F_2$; any missing answer causes rejection.
